title: Concept: Dependency resolved through another configuration
description: build.gradle declares a dependency whose target configuration is overridden, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a dependency whose target configuration is overridden.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a dependency whose target configuration is overridden.
